overview.description: The AllianzIM U.S. Equity Buffer20 Nov ETF (NVBW) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust over a specific holdings period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral NVBW was launched on Oct 31, 2022 and is issued by Allianz.
